ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65:35 ratio of high-intensity (white/light-grey) distal regions to low-intensity (black/dark-grey) central and basal regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: A primary contiguous low-intensity dark mass occupies the central 40% of the fluke width, radiating from the notch towards the leading edge. High-intensity white contiguous blocks occupy the distal 30% of each lobe, featuring sparse, localized low-intensity pixel speckling (mottling) predominantly on the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Broad, shallow U-shaped depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 150 degrees relative to the lobe mid-lines.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations visible across the horizontal span. A distinct high-amplitude irregularity (protruding tissue flap) is located on the left lobe trailing edge approximately 75% of the distance from the notch to the tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curve initiating at the median notch and transitioning to an upward vertical sweep at the distal terminals.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-contrast, roughly circular clusters of beige/grey pixels located on the extreme lateral tips of both the left and right lobes, consistent with barnacle colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, unaligned dark linear pixel disruptions visible on the white ventral surface of the inner-right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent curved flesh protrusion or partially detached tissue tag on the trailing edge of the left lobe; heavy barnacle encrustation causing significant textural distortion on both fluke tips.
other_distinctive_markers: The trailing edge of the left lobe exhibits a unique 'hooked' silhouette anomaly that breaks the symmetry of the fluke's geometric contour.
